title: rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs orphaned - not declared in lib.rs
description: Code review finding: slot.rs (908 lines) with complete SlotAllocator, conflict resolution (GCP-6.3), superframe timing (GCP-6.1), and 27 tests exists but is NOT declared in lib.rs. Module is orphaned and not compiled into the crate. discovery.rs and resources.rs that use it are also orphaned. Fix: add 'mod slot;' to lib.rs and wire up exports.
close_reason: Wired slot.rs into lib.rs: added pub use exports for SlotAllocator and AllocationMode. cargo check passes.
